title: Military Appreciation Rate
discount: At least 15% off the property’s Standard Rate at participating U.S. and Canadian hotels

title: Military Appreciation Rate
discount: A percentage off the Best Flexible Rate at participating hotels, with a minimum of 5% available at IHG hotels overall

title: Government & Military Rates
discount: U.S. government and military per diem rates, plus a discounted Military Family Rate for leisure stays. Hilton does not publish a single percentage on its program page.

title: Military/Veteran Leisure Rate
discount: A special leisure rate at participating hotels. Choice does not publish a single percentage on its program page.

title: U.S. Government & Military Discount
discount: Discounts at or below per diem at Best Western Hotels & Resorts throughout North America. No single percentage is published.

title: Military & Government Leisure Discount
discount: 5% off base rates for Government Leisure Travel. Official Government Travel uses contracted rates, not this leisure percentage.

title: Government and Military Leisure Rentals
discount: A leisure government discount CDP is pre-populated when you book through Hertz’s official government and military page. Hertz does not publish the percentage.

title: Military discounts via WeSalute, plus a veteran/military family AWD
discount: Avis states that active military, veterans, and their families can receive military discounts when they enroll in WeSalute. Avis’s official coupons page also lists AWD T765700 as up to 25% off base rates for veteran and military family.

title: Active-Duty Military Leisure Discount and travel benefits
discount: 5% off the published base fare on select United and United Express operated flights purchased on united.com or the United app, plus checked-bag and boarding benefits described on the official page

title: Military fares, bags, and boarding
discount: Government or military fares in some markets (call Reservations). Free checked bags for active U.S. military with ID: up to 3 bags, 50 lbs each, on personal/leisure travel; up to 5 bags, 100 lbs each, for active military and/or dependents traveling on orders.

title: Military baggage allowance and related benefits
discount: Free checked bags for active U.S. military: 5 bags on military orders; for personal travel, 2 bags in Delta Main/Comfort (including Basic experiences) and 3 bags in Premium Select, Delta First, and Delta One. Delta’s official page also states there is a military discount on flights and Delta Vacations, but it does not publish a percentage on that baggage page.

title: Military fares, bags, and priority boarding
discount: Military fares are offered but are not available on Southwest.com — book by phone or at a ticket counter. Active-duty customers are exempt from the two-piece bag limit and from excess, oversize, and overweight bag charges if no bag exceeds 100 lbs or 80 inches.

title: Veterans and Military Purchase Program
discount: 10% off Apple products and accessories in the official Veterans and Military Store

title: Samsung Offer Program — Military
discount: Exclusive savings up to 30% off, which Samsung says can be combined with public and seasonal offers. The amount of savings differs across product lines.

title: Dell Heroes / Military Discount
discount: Exclusive member discounts on eligible PCs and electronics on Dell.com. Dell’s official Heroes page does not publish a single percentage.

title: Military and veteran discount
discount: Up to 10% off select physical consumer products from the Microsoft Store

title: HP Frontline Heroes Store
discount: Exclusive savings of up to 40% for eligible members of the military community and other frontline groups listed in HP’s terms

title: Toyota Military Rebate
discount: $500 rebate toward any new Toyota vehicle purchased or leased through a dealer and Toyota Financial Services

title: Hyundai Military Program
discount: $500 bonus toward the purchase or lease of an eligible new Hyundai vehicle. Offer is good January 7, 2026 through December 31, 2026.

title: Jeep Military Incentive
discount: $500 Military Bonus Cash Allowance on select 2026 and 2025 Jeep vehicles

title: GM Military Appreciation Program
discount: A special offer on eligible new Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, or Cadillac vehicles. GM’s official program page does not publish a single dollar amount. The offer can be combined with most current offers, with listed exceptions.

title: Ford and Lincoln Military Recognition Program
discount: An exclusive cash reward toward the purchase or lease of eligible new Ford or Lincoln vehicles. The official program states the amount may vary by market; there is no single national dollar figure on the pages we used. Enter a ZIP code on fordrecognizesu.com to see the current offer. Program FAQ valid January 6, 2026–January 4, 2027.

title: Military Discount
discount: 10% off eligible in-stock purchases, with a $400 maximum annual discount that resets each calendar year

title: Everyday Military Discount
discount: 10% off eligible full-price purchases, with no annual maximum stated on the official program page

title: Military online tuition rates
discount: Online undergraduate rate of $250 per credit hour ($750 per course; $7,500 for 30 credits) and online graduate rate of $470 per credit hour ($1,410 per course; $7,050 for 15 credits) for eligible service members and spouses, versus standard online rates of $354 and $659 per credit hour. Rates are effective as of June 2026, per SNHU.

title: Military tuition rates for service members
discount: Undergraduate certificates, associate, and bachelor’s tuition of $750 per course ($250 per credit hour) for eligible service members. A $180 resource fee may be waived for eligible undergraduate students using Department of Defense Tuition Assistance.

title: AT&T Appreciation Savings
discount: 10% off AT&T Value 2.0, 15% off Extra 2.0, and 20% off Premium 2.0 plan lines, on up to 10 eligible phone lines. The military member must be the primary account holder.

title: T-Mix with Military Savings
discount: Discounted T-Mix plans (Saver, Standard, More, and Loaded) for eligible military customers. T-Mobile’s official page does not publish a single percentage off standard rates.

title: Verizon military discounts
discount: Official military discounts on wireless plans, Fios internet, and 25% off select accessories (online only). Verizon’s military homepage we reviewed does not publish a single percentage off every wireless plan, so we do not invent one.

title: Nike military discount
discount: 10% off most items online and in U.S. Nike stores, applied to the first $500 of a qualified purchase

title: adidas Heroes discount
discount: The official page is titled as a 30% off Heroes discount, available online, in-store, and at factory outlets after ID.me verification, subject to monthly caps and a long exclusion list

title: Under Armour military and first-responder discount
discount: 20% off purchases on UA.com, the UA App, and UA Brand House; 10% at UA Factory House

title: lululemon military discount
discount: 15% off purchases online and in-store on lululemon gear, including regular-price, We Made Too Much, and lululemon lab

title: Carhartt ID.me checkout discount
discount: 15% off the current order after ID.me validation online; the ID.me account can be reused on future Carhartt orders

title: Foot Locker military discount
discount: 10% off most online and store purchases, limited to four SheerID verifications on a rolling 30-day basis and a $100 maximum military discount per verification

title: America the Beautiful Military Passes
discount: Free annual or lifetime pass covering entrance or standard amenity (day-use) fees at lands managed by NPS, BLM, Bureau of Reclamation, USFWS, USFS, and USACE

title: Complimentary 12-month LinkedIn Premium (military community offer)
discount: One-time complimentary 12-month LinkedIn Premium subscription. After 12 months the subscription ends automatically. Codes are first-come, first-served and the program may reach capacity.

title: GE Appliances military and frontline store
discount: Exclusive pricing in a private GE Appliances Store after ID.me verification, on appliances purchased through that store that are $99 or above. The official page captured November 18, 2026, does not state a percentage, so we do not invent one.
